name: Sikkimese Tea (Temi Tea)
ingredients: Temi Tea leaves (Sikkim organic black tea)
Optional: Fresh yak milk or cow milk
Optional: A pinch of crushed cardamom or ginger for flavoring
instructions: 1. Bring fresh, cold filtered water to a gentle boil in a kettle.
2. Place one teaspoon of premium Temi tea leaves into a teapot or infuser per cup.
3. Pour the hot water (just off the boil) over the tea leaves to avoid scorching them.
4. Steep for 3 to 4 minutes to allow the distinct muscatel flavor to develop.
5. Strain the tea into a cup immediately.
6. Add a dash of milk or a sweetener like honey if desired, though it is traditionally enjoyed plain to appreciate its floral notes.
description: Temi Tea is the pride of Sikkim, grown in the state's only tea garden located in Ravangla. It is world-renowned for its exquisite flavor, golden color, and superior quality. Culturally, serving a cup of Temi tea is a symbol of Sikkimese hospitality, reflecting the pristine, misty, and high-altitude landscape of the Himalayan region.
